citations.quote: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations. Loss caused by the following is considered other than collision: ... breakage of glass.

output.reasoning: The claimant describes a cracked windshield caused by a stone thrown up by a truck. Under [COMP-1], breakage of glass is explicitly defined as 'other than collision' (comprehensive) coverage. The incident is a direct and accidental loss and does not fall under any listed exclusions (such as wear and tear [EXC-1] or intentional damage [EXC-4]).
